doc:
Historical test of the frozen family on data already collected (owner's request, 2026-11-13).

Plan (written and committed BEFORE any outcome of these rules is read):
  * Candle rules H2, H2b, H3, H4, H5 (2-min archive) and H8 (5-min archive):
      - thresholds frozen on the first 40% of the 2-min archive's calendar days (threshold block);
      - outcomes read only on the remaining days (test block), same split date for the 5-min archive;
      - label = close-to-close proxy on archive candles: entry = close of the trigger bar, exit = close of
        the bar ending expiry_s later (it must exist exactly), at the nominal payout (0.84 turbo, 0.86 binary);
      - the look is the first n_target non-overlapping trades of the test block, else the whole block.
  * Event rules H1, H6, H7 and the H1 control (live window 2026-07-31 to 2026-08-20):
      - 1-s candle labels and the payout in force, exactly as the forward block (labels.label);
      - payout steps from init-snapshot samples, previous sample at most 2 x 300 s old.
  * Same certificate (certify.evaluate), same alpha 0.05/8, same fail-closed H1 control and H4 placebos.
  * Evidence grade: DEVELOPMENT. The archive was mined by the earlier lab for other rules, the live window
    was read for the crowd-level fade, and archive labels are a bar-close proxy. A CERTIFIED row here earns
    a short forward confirmation of that one row, not money. A non-certified row is retired.

Run once: .venv-lab/bin/python -m services.otc_sparse_prereg.historical --run
name: historical test of the frozen sparse-entry family

family.name: Extreme 2-min move fade
family.trigger: abs(z0) >= per-asset 99.5% quantile of abs(z0) frozen on the archive

family.name: Strict extreme 2-min move fade
family.trigger: abs(z0) >= per-asset 99.9% quantile of abs(z0) frozen on the archive

family.name: Anchor-gap reversion
family.trigger: abs(gap) > 2.5 on the first bar of the excursion, gap = (log c - mean log c over last 720 bars) / (vol60 * sqrt(720))

family.name: Round-number first-touch fade
family.trigger: close within 0.01% of the nearest 0.0050 lattice level (0.50 JPY); max distance from that level over the prior 5 bars >= 8 pips; no touch in the prior 30 bars; must beat 99th pct of 1,000 placebo lattices

family.name: Breadth-extreme fade
family.trigger: abs(mkt0) >= pooled 99.0% quantile frozen on the archive; one trade per timestamp, on the same-sign asset with the largest abs(z0)

family.name: Payout step-down crowd fade
family.trigger: payout (turbo or binary) falls >= 0.03 vs that product's previous sample; steps within 300 s merged; nearest prior turbo mood within 60 s has 0.05 < call fraction < 0.95, != 0.5; must also beat the matched mood-only control

family.name: Payout step-up mirror
family.trigger: payout (turbo or binary) rises >= 0.03, merged as H1; nearest prior turbo mood within 60 s != 0.5

family.name: Quote-stall resume fade
family.side: against the jump across the gap
family.trigger: gap >= 60 s between consecutive received quotes on the asset; decision at the first quote after the gap

gates.G1: weekday-path replay: one cross-day path-correlation statistic per asset at lags 1 and 5 days vs day-shuffled and circularly shifted surrogates, Holm over 15 assets; a pass only unlocks a separately registered family
gates.G2: planted-edge power check: evals/eval_power.py must recover a +5 pt edge at the registered n with power >= 0.80 and certify a true null at most at rate ALPHA
gates.G3: known-null pipeline control: the full trigger-label-certificate pipeline on a memoryless random walk must certify nothing (evals/eval_power.py); Deriv volatility ticks to be added as G3b
